newsitem.title: USA: Thermo TerraTech plans to buy Carlan.
newsitem.headline: Thermo TerraTech plans to buy Carlan.

text.p: Thermo TerraTech Inc said on Tuesday it signed a letter of intent to buy privately held Carlan Consulting Group Inc, which provides transportation and environmental consulting services, for an undisclosed sum.
Florida-based Carlan, which also provides professional engineering services, had gross revenues of about $6 million for its fiscal year ended December 31, Thermo said.
Thermo, which provides environmental services and infrastructure planning and design, said the acquisition would expand its operations into northwest Florida.
The deal was subject to negotiation of a definitive agreement, it said.
